Computing & programming

bug report noun and verb

also report a bug

our formation

relātiō dē mendō

Our descriptive phrase. relātiō, relātiōnis f. — report or account. The earlier discussion used relātiō dē vitiō; both describe a report about a fault.

Examples

  • Dē hōc mendō jam rettulī.

    I’ve already reported this bug.composed

Other words

  • dē mendō referre — report a bug

    our formation

  • relātiō dē vitiō

    also used · our formation

See also bug, debug, reproduce a bug.

SourcesLewis & Short: relatio · Lewis & Short: mendum. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
